# Workflows

## Purpose

This directory contains GitHub Actions workflow definitions for the AutoForge AI repository. Workflows automate CI/CD processes including linting, testing, building, and deployment.

## Current Status

No workflows have been implemented yet. This directory is prepared for future workflow definitions.

## Planned Workflows

- **CI** — Run linting, type checking, and tests on pull requests and pushes to main
- **Release** — Automated versioning, changelog generation, and publishing
- **Documentation** — Build and deploy documentation site
- **Docker** — Build and push Docker images
- **Dependency Review** — Review dependency changes for security vulnerabilities

## Future Contents

- `ci.yml` — Continuous integration workflow
- `release.yml` — Release and publish workflow
- `docs.yml` — Documentation build and deploy workflow
- `docker.yml` — Docker image build and push workflow
